```tla+
---------------------------- MODULE GameOfLife ----------------------------
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

CONSTANT N

ASSUME N \in Nat /\ N > 0

Positions == (0..N-1) \X (0..N-1)

VARIABLE grid

TypeOK == grid \in [Positions -> BOOLEAN]

RECURSIVE SumSet(_, _)
SumSet(f, S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET x == CHOOSE x \in S : TRUE
         IN f[x] + SumSet(f, S \ {x})

Neighbors(x, y) ==
    {<<x + dx, y + dy>> : dx \in {-1, 0, 1}, dy \in {-1, 0, 1}} \ {<<x, y>>}

IsAlive(pos) ==
    IF pos \in Positions THEN grid[pos] ELSE FALSE

LiveNeighborCount(x, y) ==
    LET neighborSet == Neighbors(x, y)
        aliveFunc == [p \in neighborSet |-> IF IsAlive(p) THEN 1 ELSE 0]
    IN SumSet(aliveFunc, neighborSet)

NextCellState(x, y) ==
    LET count == LiveNeighborCount(x, y)
        alive == grid[<<x, y>>]
    IN IF alive
       THEN count \in {2, 3}
       ELSE count = 3

Init == grid \in [Positions -> BOOLEAN]

Next == grid' = [pos \in Positions |-> NextCellState(pos[1], pos[2])]

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_grid

AllDead == \A pos \in Positions : ~grid[pos]
AllAlive == \A pos \in Positions : grid[pos]
AtLeastOneAlive == \E pos \in Positions : grid[pos]

PopulationCount ==
    LET countFunc == [pos \in Positions |-> IF grid[pos] THEN 1 ELSE 0]
    IN SumSet(countFunc, Positions)

GridBounded == PopulationCount <= N * N

=============================================================================
```
